title: Hymn on Ezra 2
verse1: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;
chorus: Your word in Ezra 2 endures across every generation.
verse2: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
bridge: Guide our steps in quiet truth today.
